I5.quote: The hydrogen storage capacities of nanoporous carbons, simulated as flat graphene slit pores, have been calculated using a quantum-thermodynamical model.

notes: Purely computational paper (DFT-LDA and MP2 potentials in a quantum-thermodynamical model). Evidence: "The hydrogen storage capacities of nanoporous carbons, simulated as flat graphene slit pores, have been calculated using a quantum-thermodynamical model." (main, p. 1, Abstract). Experimental curves are taken from other papers: "Excess hydrogen gravimetric storage capacities of two samples of ACs (named KUA1 and KUA5) measured by Jorda-Beneyto et al. (Ref. 26)" (main, p. 6, Fig. 8 caption) and "Excess hydrogen gravimetric storage capacity of CDCs derived from TiC measured by Gogotsi et al. (Ref. 23)" (main, p. 7, Fig. 9 caption). Not a review, not retracted (record is_retracted false; no retraction notice in PDF). Text layer was clear; page images not needed.
